lines.text: The Spirit of God came upon Azariah son of Oded, and he went out to meet Asa.
Asa took courage and removed the idols from Judah, Benjamin, and Ephraim's hill country, then restored the altar of the LORD.
They gathered in Jerusalem in the third month of Asa's twentieth year and sacrificed seven hundred oxen and seven thousand sheep.
They covenanted to seek the LORD with all their heart and soul, and whoever refused would be put to death.
Asa removed his mother Michaiah from her position as queen mother because she made an Asherah pole, and he burned it in the Kidron Valley.
